carousels.title: AI Home Value Estimates: The End of Zestimate?
carousels.caption:
Forget the Zestimate. New AI tools are changing how we value homes, mixing big data with homeowner details. This shift means more accurate appraisals, less guessing for loan officers, and quicker closes. It's not just about tech; it's about better data for better decisions across the board. The impact on underwriting is massive: clearer, more defensible valuations. What's your take on AI's role in home valuation? Will it truly replace traditional methods?

Source : https://tinyurl.com/24ktp22p
#SafetrustMortgage #MortgageIntelligenceDaily #homevaluation #realestatetech #mortgagebroker
carousels.hook: AVMs like Zestimate are dead. AI is the new king.
carousels.what_happened: Consumers are moving away from Automated Valuation Models (AVMs) like Zestimate. They are now using new AI-powered tools for home value estimates and decision support.

breakdown.heading: The Old Way: Limited Data
breakdown.body: Traditional AVMs rely on public records and limited market data. This often creates a generic valuation that misses unique property features.

breakdown.heading: The New Way: Informed AI
breakdown.body: Next-gen AI models combine vast market data with homeowner-provided specifics. This includes details like recent upgrades or unique property characteristics.

breakdown.heading: Underwriter Lens: Accuracy is Key
breakdown.body: For underwriters, better data means more accurate and defensible valuations. This reduces conditions and appraisal disputes, speeding up approval times.

breakdown.heading: Impact on Appraisals
breakdown.body: While not replacing human appraisers yet, AI tools will inform their work. They provide a richer dataset upfront, streamlining the appraisal process.

carousels.my_take: This isn't just a tech upgrade; it's a transparency revolution. Underwriters will demand more granular data. Lenders who integrate AI for pre-valuation insights will pull ahead on turn times and client satisfaction. Don't chase the tech, chase the better data.
carousels.action_lo: Educate clients on how to provide detailed property info to inform new AI tools for more accurate pre-approvals.
carousels.action_realtor: Advise sellers to meticulously document upgrades and unique features; this data will increasingly drive AI-based valuations.
carousels.cta_question: How will enhanced home valuation accuracy impact loan volume for your team?

carousels.title: Are We Ready for the Next Housing Downturn?
carousels.caption:
The last downturn's playbook won't work next time. Pandemic-era solutions relied on a refi boom that won't be there. Servicers need new liquidity backstops, or we'll see major failures and borrower pain. As an underwriter, I see the ripple effect: a broken servicing chain impacts future securitizations and investor confidence. We need to pressure policymakers now. What gaps do you see in our current readiness for a market correction?

Source : https://tinyurl.com/2cv8rz92
#SafetrustMortgage #MortgageIntelligenceDaily #housingmarket #mortgageservicing #housingcrisis
carousels.hook: We are NOT ready for the next housing downturn.
carousels.what_happened: Pandemic-era forbearance plans relied on servicer liquidity, boosted by a refinance boom and low rates. A future downturn, especially during inflation, could expose servicers to significant liquidity shortfalls.

breakdown.heading: The Pandemic Playbook
breakdown.body: Forbearance worked because servicers had cash. They funded missed payments, knowing the refi market would recoup losses quickly.

breakdown.heading: No Refi Boom Next Time
breakdown.body: In a high-rate, inflationary environment, the refi market won't be there. Servicers can't rely on it to cover forbearance advances.

breakdown.heading: Underwriter Lens: Servicer Risk
breakdown.body: Underwriters assess servicer strength. If servicing goes sideways, it jeopardizes the entire loan ecosystem, from originations to investor confidence.

breakdown.heading: Policy Gap: No New Backstops
breakdown.body: Policymakers haven't created new liquidity backstops. Without them, servicers could fail, leading to borrower harm and market instability.

carousels.my_take: The silence on servicer liquidity is deafening. This isn't just a servicer problem; it's a systemic risk. Originators: your loans are only as good as the servicing that follows. Pressure policymakers for clarity and solutions before it's too late.
carousels.action_lo: Stay informed on servicer health and potential policy changes. Diversify your investor base if possible.
carousels.action_realtor: Understand that a future downturn could impact client trust in homeownership. Be a resource for accurate information.
carousels.cta_question: What's your biggest concern about servicer liquidity in a prolonged downturn?

carousels.title: TransUnion Adds Alternative Credit Signals
carousels.caption:
TransUnion just expanded its mortgage credit report with alternative credit data. This isn't just another data point; it's a game-changer for evaluating borrowers often overlooked by traditional scoring. As an underwriter, this means a clearer picture of financial responsibility for those with thin files. It opens doors, mitigates risk, and drives smart growth. Are you ready to leverage these new insights? How will this impact your approach to challenging files?

Source : https://tinyurl.com/2dpn8x33
#SafetrustMortgage #MortgageIntelligenceDaily #creditscore #mortgageunderwriting #firsttimehomebuyer
carousels.hook: Alternative credit data is now in your mortgage report.
carousels.what_happened: TransUnion has enhanced its mortgage credit report by adding alternative credit data. This provides lenders with earlier insights into borrower behavior during the loan origination process.

breakdown.heading: Beyond Traditional Scores
breakdown.body: The new data, TruVision™ Alternative Credit Attributes (ACA 2.0), comes from FactorTrust® Alternative Lending Database. It captures payment history outside of typical credit cards or loans.

breakdown.heading: Underwriter Lens: Holistic View
breakdown.body: I can now see a more complete picture of a borrower's financial habits. This reduces guesswork for applicants with limited traditional credit history.

breakdown.heading: Earlier Risk Signals
breakdown.body: Lenders get insights earlier in the process. This can help identify potential issues or strengths that traditional reports might miss, improving loan quality.

carousels.my_take: This isn't about loosening standards; it's about smarter underwriting. We're gaining a clearer lens into responsible financial behavior that traditional scores miss. This means more qualified borrowers for us, and more homeowners for America. Lean into this data.
carousels.action_lo: Understand how to articulate the benefits of alternative credit data to clients, especially those with thin credit files.
carousels.action_realtor: Partner with lenders using these enhanced reports. It can expand the pool of qualified buyers for your listings.
carousels.cta_question: How will alternative credit data impact your ability to serve first-time homebuyers?
